scope: Documentation-derived inventory, not runtime configuration or an exhaustive data-discovery result. See docs/privacy.md for precise controls and limitations.

datasets.contents: Names, time, result, optional client identity, policy and validation provenance
datasets.limits: Query logging and client-attribution controls; no retrospective all-copies erasure

datasets.contents: Network/category aggregates and blocked domains; not automatically anonymous
datasets.limits: Independent rollup retention; network and domain context can remain sensitive

datasets.contents: Policy outcomes, original evidence and optional attributed context
datasets.retention: 30 days by default; log.decision_retention_days, 0 or less disables expiry
datasets.limits: Capture lifetime follows decision; logging admission controls new records

datasets.contents: Measured signals, example names, device/network context and review notes/actor labels
datasets.retention: 30-day finding default; detection.retention_days 0 disables expiry; review rows cascade with findings
datasets.limits: Detection and logging controls; historical findings are not retroactively reclassified

datasets.contents: Domains, external/local claims and bounded response excerpts
datasets.retention: Per-record expiry; some local/operator claims do not expire
datasets.limits: Separate provider controls; turning logging off does not delete caches

datasets.contents: Network/client names, policy/settings, hashes/ciphertext, actor/change records
datasets.retention: Configuration until changed/deleted; session expiry; change history currently unpruned
datasets.limits: Authenticated management and redaction; host access and retention are separate

datasets.contents: Finding/review payloads and delivery state; may include names/addresses/notes
datasets.retention: Queue bounded; completed/terminal payloads removed; files/SIEM have separate lifetimes
datasets.limits: Consent and receiver configuration; cannot recall already delivered events

datasets.contents: Client-attributed statistical baselines; no raw queried names in checkpoint
datasets.retention: Default client idle lifetime 24h; active baselines survive restarts
datasets.limits: Sensitive metadata, not anonymised; disabling learning does not erase checkpoint

datasets.storage: secrets.key, source YAML, TLS keys, trust anchors, feed caches
datasets.contents: Credential master key/private keys; YAML may include old secrets; anchors are public trust state
datasets.limits: Private filesystem permissions and host protection; whole SQLite/WAL not application-encrypted

datasets.storage: NDJSON exports, .ddbackup, operational/container/proxy logs, external copies
datasets.contents: Potentially repeated retained data, configuration and secrets in recovery packages
datasets.limits: Exports plaintext; backups passphrase-encrypted; erasure/expiry must include restores and recipients

outbound_paths: Configured DNS forwarders (fresh default Cloudflare DoH)
Native authoritative DNS in Native Learn/Live
Background hostname DNS; selected profile determines recipient
Enabled threat-feed HTTP downloads (fresh default: urlhaus.abuse.ch, raw.githubusercontent.com, phishing.army, blocklistproject.github.io)
Authenticated operator exports/backups and subsequent operator-managed sharing
warning: Operator acknowledgement is not automatically a data subject consent or other lawful basis. Logging off does not prevent DNS resolution or all separately enabled disclosures.
